question: 已知 $a_{n} = \int_{0}^{n}\frac{\arctan\frac{x}{n}}{(1 + x)(1 + x^{2})}\mathrm{d}x, n = 1,2,\dots$ ，求 $\lim_{n\to \infty}na_n$ ：
answer: \begin{array}{r l} & n \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {x}{n} - \frac {1}{3} \left(\frac {x}{n}\right) ^ {3}}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {x}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{3 n ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {x ^ {3}}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x, \\ & \quad \lim _ {n \to \infty} \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {x}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1 + x}{1 + x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{1 + x}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & \quad = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{2} \arctan x + \frac {1}{4} \ln \frac {1 + x ^ {2}}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \right] _ {0} ^ {n} = \frac {\pi}{4}. \\ & \quad \lim _ {n \to \infty} \frac {1}{3 n ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {x ^ {3}}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {t \to + \infty} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {t} \frac {x ^ {3}}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} \mathrm{d} x}{t ^ {2}} \\ & \quad = \lim _ {t \to + \infty} \frac {\overline {{(1 + t) (1 + t ^ {2})}}}{2 t} = \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {t \to + \infty} \frac {t ^ {2}}{(1 + t) (1 + t ^ {2})} = 0. \end{array}

steps.text: 分析 显然 $a_{n}$ 的积分没法计算出来，困难在于被积函数中的分子 $\arctan \frac{x}{n}$ ，若能将分子用 $x$ 的多项式来做双向估计，并保持放大与缩小后的极限不变，问题就解决了。
根据不等式： $t > 0$ 时， $t > \arctan t > t - \frac{1}{3} t^3$ （用函数的单调性容易证明），可得
n \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {x}{n} - \frac {1}{3} \left(\frac {x}{n}\right) ^ {3}}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} d x <   n a _ {n} <   \int_ {0} ^ {n} \frac {x}{(1 + x) (1 + x ^ {2})} d x.\tag{①}
